Project: Predict, then run

This assumes The fxctl tool and Reading what fx printed.

This lesson serves the criterion "run fx on a new input and check the prediction": write your prediction for fx(5), then see 30 printed. You will build it whole.

Complete the command that prints fx(5), then check the output against your prediction.

$ node -e "console.log(fx(____))"
30

Run the check. You should see 30 printed.

node -e "console.log(fx(5))"

You can now predict an output of fx and check it by running it.
